meta_description: FinOps & Sustainable Computing from Dataq Software: scope, delivery pattern, platforms and committed outcomes.

blocks.x: FinOps & Sustainable Computing, delivered by a named pod: the scope, the rhythm, the rails, and the numbers we are willing to be measured on.

Cloud spend becomes rational when it becomes unit economics: cost per transaction, per customer, per model inference. We implement FinOps as an engineering discipline — tagging and allocation architecture, showback and chargeback per team, commitment strategies (reserved/spot mix) with utilization tracking, and architectural cost reviews where the expensive path is redesigned before it is deployed, not after the invoice.

Sustainability rides the same instrumentation: carbon telemetry per workload (compute, storage, network), scheduling flexibility for carbon-aware batch windows, right-sizing programs, and efficiency metrics per service. For sustainability-reporting clients we produce the data foundation for ESG disclosures — auditable, tagged and reproducible, aligned to GHG Protocol scope treatment for cloud.

This capability runs on the cadence set out below; the rhythm is fixed, the scope is signed. The first quarter of the rhythm is verification: weeks 1–2 measure the current metric with your team and lock it by signature. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with your control owner receiving evidence weekly. Weeks 9–12 industrialize: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and the measured delta against the signed baseline. Gates are binding: miss one and the program stops or redirects with a documented decision.
